newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai exchange halts trade in Sitca.
newsitem.headline: Thai exchange halts trade in Sitca.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Thailand said on Tuesday it halted trade in shares of Sitca Investment and Securities Plc for the morning session as it awaited a disclosure from the company.
Thai media on Tuesday reported that Sitca, a medium-sized finance and securities company, had held talks aimed at securing a tie-up with Bangkok Metropolitan Bank Plc.
According to the reports, Sitca wanted to buy into Bangkok Metropolitan Bank Plc's forthcoming five billion baht capital increase.
Senior Sitca executives had previously stated their ambitions to move into Thailand's commercial banking sector.
Sitca's recent attempt to take over the beleagured Bangkok Bank of Commerce Plc failed after negotiations with the Bank of Thailand broke down.
